blocks.title: Impact
blocks.text:
Since 2001, Processing has grown from a tool for artists and designers into a global movement shaping how people learn, teach, and create with code across every continent. 

By maintaining creative coding software as a commons, resourcing the people who maintain it, and building pathways for those who learn with our tools, Processing Foundation expands who gets to shape technology and culture.

blocks.title: We create impact through our tools, partnerships, and community engagements
Impact Report 2025
blocks.body:
The 2025 Impact Report marks a pivotal year of evolution for Processing Foundation, highlighting strategic program growth and deepening community engagement. 

Learn more about the software releases, educational initiatives, and work being done to build a more equitable and accessible creative coding ecosystem.

statements.title: Art
statements.description: Processing has shaped the way the world sees code as a medium for art. By keeping tools accessible, artist-friendly, and open-source tools, Processing and p5.js have lowered the barrier to entry, empowering a generation of artists to develop generative, interactive, and algorithmic art.

statements.title: Education
statements.description: Free, open-source, and built for learners, these tools have aided teachers, researchers, and students in understanding the creative potential of code.

statements.title: Community
statements.description: Processing is more than just software. It is a community built by thousands of people committed to making computing and expression accessible for everyone.

blocks.title: Join the Movement
blocks.body: You don’t need to be a coder to get involved. Help build the future with Processing Foundation through a financial contribution or partnership.
